chunks: He said: "O Lord, I have killed a man of theirs, and fear they would kill me."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud pray when he feared for his life?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often attributed to Prophet Hud (peace be upon him) or sometimes to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) during the Battle of Badr, reflecting the moment after slaying a key adversary. It underscores the psychological weight of taking a life, even in self-defense or justice, and the subsequent reliance on divine protection from the remaining tribe. This supplication serves as a model for believers to acknowledge their vulnerability and seek God's safeguarding against retribution.
